note: Ghana, read on the Ghana Immigration Service's own pages on 2026-10-30 (its fees and charges effective 15 May 2025, set in US dollars for permits, at GH¢11 to the dollar). A foreign national lawfully admitted to Ghana who wishes to work and reside applies by a letter to the Comptroller-General with the employing company's papers, so the permit is asked for in the country and tied to the company. The work and residence permit (companies) costs $1,293 for other nationals ($647 for ECOWAS nationals, $194 for Ghanaians with a foreign passport); the file's fees are in dollars, as the table sets them. ECOWAS nationals pay the lower rate for the same permit; the service's pages name no separate free movement residence for them, so none is written. Indefinite residence status lets its holder remain indefinitely, enter without a visa and work as self-employed or employee without a work permit; its fee row gives GH¢10,000 and $18,000 under three columns without saying which is which, so no fee is written. Term, decision time and the years before indefinite residence aren't stated on these pages.

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service, Work and Residence Permit (Companies)
sources.said: A foreign national who has been lawfully admitted entry into Ghana and wishes to work and reside in the country may submit an application letter for a Work and Residence permit addressed to the Comptroller-General of Immigration.

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service, Indefinite Residence Status Generally
sources.said: Indefinite Residence status can be obtained by a foreign national who wishes to reside permanently in Ghana. A person with indefinite residence status is entitled to remain indefinitely in Ghana; entitled to enter Ghana without a visa; entitled to work in Ghana as a self-employed or as an employee without a work permit.
